description: What a freshly created character looks like where MeowDB MS Classic is silent. The canonical creation facts are NOT repeated here: CharacterFactory reads level 1, the 4/4/4/4 starting stats, the 9 creation AP, base HP/MP and free AP from data/canonical/formulas/beginner.json, the creation weapons from the items flagged beginner_creation_weapon, and the respawn reference from the start map's canonical return map. See docs/runtime/SAVES.md.

start_location.reason: MeowDB's Beginner's guide says only 'You start on Maple Island' and the map list marks no start map (docs/canonical/maps.md, Gaps; docs/canonical/README.md, known gaps). 000000001 Mushroom Town - West Entrance is the inferred start: 4 player spawns, no arrival portal, and Heena's first quest (1000). Player spawn 0 because MeowDB lists the points but not which one a new character uses (MAP_ARCHITECTURE.md open question 1).

starting_exp.reason: MeowDB states no starting EXP. The EXP table counts EXP toward the next level, and a new level-1 character has earned none.

starting_sp.reason: formulas/beginner.json sp.calculator_caveat: 'per the Beginner's guide a Beginner has 0 SP at level 1 and gains 1 SP at each level-up from 2 to 10'. MeowDB states it in prose only (no numeric field), so the number lives here with that quote.
starting_sp.verified_against: game/data/canonical/formulas/beginner.json sp.calculator_caveat ('a Beginner has 0 SP at level 1', quoting MeowDB's Beginner's guide)

starting_mesos.reason: MeowDB documents no starting mesos: the Beginner class page, the Beginner's guide and the leveling formulas are silent, and formulas/beginner.json lists 'Starting clothes / starting inventory: not documented' under gaps. A new character starts with an empty purse.

starting_fame.reason: MeowDB documents no starting fame. A new character has received no fame.

starting_inventory.reason: formulas/beginner.json gaps: 'Starting clothes / starting inventory: not documented' (starter_clothes is null). No clothes, potions or other items are granted; only the chosen creation weapon.

starter_weapon.reason: The Beginner's guide says 'Choose the Wooden Club at character creation' (items 541/576/585 carry beginner_creation_weapon). MeowDB does not say whether the chosen weapon starts equipped or in the bag; the classic creation screen shows it in the character's hand, so it is equipped. If the Equipment API cannot equip it, CharacterFactory falls back to the inventory and reports that.

name_rules.reason: MeowDB documents no character-name rules. 4 to 12 ASCII letters and digits follows the classic creation screen and keeps names safe for save-slot listings and the UI fonts.

quick_start.name: Beginner
quick_start.reason: Parameters Game.new_game() uses when called with none (boot without a creation screen, debug 'reset_save', tests). They follow the Beginner's guide's advice: 'Safe split for new players: all of it in your primary until level 10', 'STR gives a Beginner stronger basic attacks than INT does', and 'Choose the Wooden Club at character creation' (item 585).
